lines.text: Beloved children are told to imitate God and walk in love, as Christ gave Himself up for us.
No immoral, impure, or greedy person has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
Paul warns that because of such things, the famine of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
Believers are now light in the Lord, so they walk as children of obedience and expose fruitless deeds.
Believers are told not to get drunk on wine, but to be filled with the Spirit.
